methods.name: OLS, GLS, clustered and HAC fits without intercept: uncentered R2, adjusted R2 with n, F on k df
methods.reference: stats::lm / summary.lm with attr(terms, 'intercept') == 0; sandwich::vcovHC(type = 'HC1'), vcovCL(cluster = ~firm | ~firm + year, type = 'HC1'), NeweyWest(lag = 4, prewhite = FALSE)
quantities: SE classical, HC1, CR1 firm, CR1 firm + year, Newey-West lag 4
R2 and adjusted R2 (uncentered without intercept)
F and R2 with the intercept column last (run_ols_raw)
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 200: coefficients 1e-8, SE and statistics 1e-6 relative; p-values also 1e-12 absolute; df and counts exact

methods.name: p2a reg ols/clustered/hac/gls/step/quantreg --intercept false and reg clustered --cluster2
methods.reference: stats::lm without intercept; sandwich::vcovCL(~firm, ~firm + year, type = 'HC1'), NeweyWest(lag = 4, prewhite = FALSE); stats::step(direction = 'backward'), extractAIC(k = 2 | log(n))
quantities: two-way CR1 SE, t, p and cluster counts
step criterion, final variables, R2 and AIC
quantreg coefficients equal p2a-core in process
methods.tolerance: text at print precision (Tol::printed: 6 decimals for coefficients, SE and R2, 3 for t, 4 for p); -F json at validation/README.md, n = 200 (coefficients 1e-8, SE and statistics 1e-6 relative, p also 1e-12 absolute); counts exact; quantreg in-process Tol::new(1e-12, 1e-15)

deviations.note: p2a's IRLS quantile regression (tol 1e-6) is not the exact LP of rq(method = 'br'); R gives 0.1116253861993205 / 0.078613841312111174 (rq_coef). The CLI test checks that --intercept false reaches quantreg() (in-process equality); T3-WP10 implements Barrodale-Roberts and can pin rq_coef.

methods.name: p2a ts ar --aic, ts stl --robust and ts spectrum --detrend
methods.reference: stats::ar(method = 'yule-walker') with aic = TRUE, aic = FALSE and order.max = 2
quantities: AR coefficients (AIC, aic = FALSE order 20, fixed order 2)
STL remainder and spectrum ordinates equal p2a-core in process for both flag values, and differ between them
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 120: coefficients and mean 1e-8, AIC 1e-6 relative; orders exact; STL and spectrum exact equality with the in-process call

deviations.note: p2a's Yule-Walker prediction variance omits ar.yw's n / (n - (order + 1)): p2a 1.012860245443493 (order 2) and 0.9090641227233529 (order 20), R 1.0388310209676848 and 1.1018959063313365 (aic_var_pred, noaic_var_pred); not pinned.
STL runs in f32 with p2a's default windows; R's stl needs s.window and differs; the test pins the CLI against run_stl in process.
the raw periodogram is 2x spec.pgram's with a different taper; the test pins the CLI against run_spectrum in process.
